_why: Exceptions for the optional local-models install only (platform/requirements-models.txt). Each needs a reason and an expiry; CI fails once one expires.

exceptions.reason: fastembed 0.9.0 (latest, 2026-10-21) requires pillow<13, so the models extra cannot take the fix. Pillow is used by fastembed only for image models, which this project never loads (text embeddings, SPLADE, text reranker). Shipped images and the default, dev and PDF sets resolve to the fixed pillow 13.0.0 and are audited with no exceptions.
